summary: Implemented every stub in src/simpy/resources/base.py: Put.cancel and Get.cancel (remove the request from its queue if not yet triggered), BaseResource.capacity, the _trigger_put and _trigger_get queue loops, and the _do_put and _do_get hooks that raise NotImplementedError. The last full-suite run (tests dir) showed 96 passed and 54 failed, with the failures in other builders' still-stubbed files (events.py, core.py, container.py and resource.py), and the base queue logic verified in isolation with a stand-in Event.
